items.name: Harvester
items.description: When this enemy deals damage, it restores its own Armor and Health. Damage it with a grenade or apply any Status Effect to disable Harvester.

items.name: One-For-All
items.description: Marked enemies give allies within 20 m 50% damage resistance. Damage dealt to the marked enemy also spreads to its allies within that radius.

items.name: Aid Specialist
items.description: Periodically repairs the Armor of nearby allies when they are heavily damaged.

items.name: Unyielding
items.description: Each enemy cleanses its Status Effects once when it crosses a set Armor or Health threshold. Crowd control can be applied again after the cleanse.

items.name: Variety Pack
items.description: Repeated kills with the same weapon reduce its Weapon Damage. Switch weapons and get a kill or assist kill to clear the penalty.

items.name: ISAC Says
items.description: Assigns a random colored debuff. Complete its matching action to clear it and gain +30% Rate of Fire.

lines.label: Yellow
lines.clear: Kill an enemy with your sidearm.
